minecraft:particle_initialization.per_update_expression: variable.t = query.day + query.time_of_day; variable.me = (variable.t - 3) / 365.25 * 360; variable.ls = (variable.t - 80) / 365.25 * 360 + 1.915 * math.sin(variable.me) + 0.02 * math.sin(2 * variable.me); variable.er = 1 - 0.0167 * math.cos(variable.me); variable.p_m = 19.41248 + variable.t / 686.98 * 360; variable.p_nu = variable.p_m + 10.690507 * math.sin(variable.p_m) + 0.6247 * math.sin(2 * variable.p_m) + 0.050564 * math.sin(3 * variable.p_m); variable.p_r = 1.51042 / (1 + 0.093394 * math.cos(variable.p_nu)); variable.p_u = variable.p_nu + 286.481301; variable.p_x = variable.p_r * (0.648658 * math.cos(variable.p_u) - 0.76108 * math.sin(variable.p_u) * 0.999479) + variable.er * math.cos(variable.ls); variable.p_y = variable.p_r * (0.76108 * math.cos(variable.p_u) + 0.648658 * math.sin(variable.p_u) * 0.999479) + variable.er * math.sin(variable.ls); variable.p_z = variable.p_r * math.sin(variable.p_u) * 0.032278; variable.dist = math.sqrt(variable.p_x * variable.p_x + variable.p_y * variable.p_y + variable.p_z * variable.p_z); variable.cosa = (variable.p_r * variable.p_r + variable.dist * variable.dist - variable.er * variable.er) / (2 * variable.p_r * variable.dist); variable.f = (1 + variable.cosa) / 2 / (variable.p_r * variable.p_r * variable.dist * variable.dist); variable.bright = 0.75 * math.clamp(math.pow(variable.f / 3.7634, 0.35), 0.12, 1); variable.lm = (variable.t - 80) / 365.25 * 360; variable.phi = math.clamp(-query.position(2) / 63710, -1, 1) * 90; variable.rs = math.atan2(math.cos(23.5) * math.sin(variable.ls), math.cos(variable.ls)); variable.ds = math.asin(math.sin(23.5) * math.sin(variable.ls)); variable.hs = query.time_of_day * 360 + 180 + variable.lm - variable.rs; variable.salt = math.asin(math.sin(variable.phi) * math.sin(variable.ds) + math.cos(variable.phi) * math.cos(variable.ds) * math.cos(variable.hs)); variable.vis = math.clamp((-3 - variable.salt) / 6, 0, 1);
